text:
maria: Heads up — canary for kernel-autotune-v2 landed ~10m ago. Seeing big tail latency on quant path (INT4/FP8) for sm95 instances. 95th went from ~90ms to ~250ms for small-seq workloads. Attaching quick profiler summary below.

sam: Oof. Is this across all batch sizes or just small batches?

maria: Mainly batches of 1-3 tokens (chat settings). Batch size distribution shifted after the new batch_kick heuristic.

jonathan: If batch_kick got lowered it can cause more cold kernels to be chosen — that + KV cache not warmed up will hit INT4 path fallback. Any logs from kernel_picker?

maria: Paste from kernel_picker log (filtered):
```
[2026-03-18T14:02:12Z] request_id=xyz arch=sm95 seq_len=8 tokens=2 selected_kernel=quant_int4_kernel_v3 fallback=fp8_kernel_v1 latency_ms=243
[2026-03-18T14:02:12Z] request_id=abc arch=sm95 seq_len=128 tokens=64 selected_kernel=fp8_kernel_v2 latency_ms=88
```

lia: Looks like hysteresis isn't preventing flip-flop between fp8 and int4 for short seqs. Our hysteresis_ms default is 5ms now? That might be too small with the new async batcher.

sam: Also check KV cache warmup heuristics. If prefix cache hasn't populated, int4 path may try to use tiled kernels that increase overhead for short seqs.

maria: I ran a quick probebench: smallseq (median 12 tokens) p95 by kernel:
- int4_kernel_v3: 240ms
- fp8_kernel_v2: 92ms
- int8_kernel_v1: 110ms
So int4 is the culprit on sm95 for smallseq, even though int4 is cheaper for long sequences.

jonathan: Can we add an explicit seq_len cutoff to avoid int4 for seq_len < 32 on sm95? Also tune hysteresis up to 12ms so we don't flip mid-batch.

lia: Proposed quick config change (to test):
```
kernel_selection:
  per_arch_overrides:
    sm95:
      seq_len_min_for_int4: 32
      hysteresis_ms: 12
  quant_thresholds:
    int8: 0.65
    int4: 0.25
    fp8: 0.9
batching:
  min_tokens: 24
  kick_ms: 6
kv_warmup:
  prefix_cache_enabled: true
  warmup_ratio: 0.8
```

sam: That seems reasonable as a canary-only tweak. Can we run a quick AB with 10% traffic?

maria: Already queued as canary-10. Running probebench against canary config now.

perf-bot: :warning: regression-detect v1.3: regression_id=reg-20260318-01; metric=p95_latency; delta=+160ms; scope=canary(all,quant-path)

jonathan: If probebench confirms improvement, we can promote to all hosts. If not, rollback to previous autotune. lia, can you open a tiny PR with those overrides + test?

lia: Will do. PR and a short e2e test that compares median/p95 for smallseq.

maria: Results from probebench (5m window) on canary-10: p95 smallseq -> 98ms (down from 250ms). Throughput unchanged.

sam: Nice. Plan: promote config for canary-50, monitor 15m, then all. Keep a manual rollback window.

jonathan: Follow-up items: 1) add automated rule to avoid int4 on seq_len < per-arch threshold; 2) increase hysteresis default when async batcher enabled; 3) add unit to ensure KV warmup vector hits before selecting quant kernels for short seqs.

maria: I'll open the incident note and attach probebench logs. If anyone sees other oddities ping me. :thumbsup:

lia: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5372 (config + tests)

sam: I'll schedule canary-50 rollout after lia's PR merges. If we still see spikes, revert and re-evaluate kernel autotune heuristics.

maria: Thanks team, keeping eyes on dashboards.
